description: Reads input from the user based on the specified mode and maximum value.
howItWorks: The method sets the echo text, requests focus, waits for input, and returns the input string if not cancelled.
howToUse: Call this method with a mode and maximum value to read input from the user.
layerReason: This method handles user interface interactions by setting the echo text and waiting for input.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode of input (e.g., AMOUNT_MODE, IDLE_MODE).

parameters.name: maxValue
parameters.description: The maximum value for the input.

postConditions: Returns a string if not cancelled.
Sets the mode to IDLE_MODE after waiting for input.
preConditions: Requests focus on the simulation display.
returns: A string representing the user's input or null if cancelled.
stereotypeReason: This method interacts with other components like SimKeyboard and Simulation to handle user input.
